description: Consommation annuelle 2012 - 2017 de gaz et d'électricité des sites industriels raccordés aux réseaux de transport de GRTgaz, Teréga et RTE sur le territoire de la Communauté urbaine de Dunkerque is a dataset listed in Open Data Dunkerque Agglomération, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by GRTgaz, RTE, Teréga. Ce jeu de données présente les consommations de gaz et d'électricité annuelles (MWh) des sites industriels raccordés aux réseaux de transport de GRTgaz, Teréga et RTE, et leur nombre, par maille géographique IRIS (dernier référentiel disponible 2020). Les mailles IRIS (Ilots Regroupés pour l'Information Statistique) sont référencées par l'INSEE. Coverage: Dunkirk urban community. The portal files it under Environnement. Its keywords are LTECV, Article 179. The portal flags it as a time series. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2018-11-06 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte v2.0 (Etalab). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-data-dunkerque-agglo-fr-portal.
